raw.details:
PROMPT RUN

Prompt. Build. Run.

PROMPT RUN is a 6-hour, fully online, individual Web Development Vibe Coding Hackathon focused on modern web technologies, rapid product development, creative problem-solving, and effective use of Vibe Coding workflows.

Participants will receive a challenge and must independently transform the given problem statement into a functional, modern web application within the 6-hour hackathon period.

This is not a traditional team hackathon. Every participant competes individually, builds their own project, submits it for automated evaluation, and competes on the official leaderboard.

HACKATHON FORMAT

Duration: 6 Hours
Mode: Fully Online
Participation: Individual
Domain: Web Development
Format: Vibe Coding
Evaluation: FAIE Automated Evaluation Engine
Ranking: Official Leaderboard
Submission Chances: 3

Participants will receive the challenge at the beginning of the event and will have six hours to plan, build, test, improve, and submit their solution.

VIBE CODING

PROMPT RUN is designed around modern Vibe Coding and rapid development workflows.

Participants can use AI-assisted development tools and modern development platforms to accelerate their workflow and transform ideas into working products.

Participants may use:

  • AI coding assistants
  • Vibe Coding platforms
  • Modern frontend frameworks
  • Component libraries
  • UI and design systems
  • Animation and interaction libraries
  • APIs and web services
  • Development and debugging tools
  • Other relevant modern web development tools

The focus is on how effectively participants can understand the challenge, develop a solution, iterate on their idea, and deliver a functional product within the given time.

MODERN TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENT

PROMPT RUN is specifically focused on modern web development.

Participants are required to use a modern framework, library, or technology stack to build their project.

Examples of acceptable technologies include:

  • React
  • Next.js
  • Vue
  • Nuxt
  • Svelte
  • SvelteKit
  • Angular
  • Astro
  • Remix
  • TypeScript-based modern frameworks
  • Modern UI/component libraries
  • Modern CSS frameworks and styling systems
  • Frontend animation and interaction libraries
  • Modern backend and API technologies where required

Participants are free to choose the technology stack that best suits their solution.

Standalone technologies are not permitted as the primary stack:

  • Raw HTML-only projects
  • Raw CSS-only projects
  • Vanilla JavaScript-only projects
  • Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript websites without a modern framework or technology stack

HTML, CSS, and JavaScript may naturally be generated or used internally by modern frameworks, but the project itself must be built using a modern web development stack.

THREE SUBMISSION CHANCES

Every participant gets 3 submission chances during the hackathon.

These three chances allow participants to improve and refine their project during the event.

Participants can:

Build → Submit → Evaluate → Improve → Resubmit

However, there is an important rule:

THE LATEST SUBMISSION IS ALWAYS CONSIDERED

The final score will be calculated from the latest valid submission made by the participant.

The highest score among the three submissions will not be automatically retained.

Example

Submission 1 — 72 points
Submission 2 — 86 points
Submission 3 — 79 points

The final considered score will be:

79 points

because Submission 3 is the latest valid submission.

Participants should therefore use their three chances strategically and ensure that their final submission represents their strongest version.

FAIE — AUTOMATED EVALUATION ENGINE

PROMPT RUN uses FAIE — Frontend Arena Intelligent Evaluation Engine to automatically evaluate submitted projects.

FAIE is an automated evaluation engine based on predefined evaluation criteria and technical checks. It is not an AI judge.

The same evaluation process is applied to participant submissions according to the defined hackathon evaluation framework.

FAIE evaluates multiple aspects of the submitted project, which may include:

  • UI/UX Quality
  • Functionality
  • Performance
  • Code Quality
  • Responsiveness
  • Accessibility
  • Problem Statement Alignment
  • Overall Technical Implementation

After evaluation, FAIE generates a score for the submitted project.

LIVE LEADERBOARD

PROMPT RUN features an official leaderboard where participants can track their current ranking.

After a submission is evaluated:

Submission → FAIE Evaluation → Score → Leaderboard

If a participant submits again, their previous submission is replaced by the latest valid submission for leaderboard purposes.

Therefore, the leaderboard always reflects the participant's latest valid evaluated score.

The leaderboard will be used to determine the final results of the hackathon.

Final Positions

Rank #1 — WINNER
Rank #2 — RUNNER-UP
Rank #3 — SECOND RUNNER-UP

The final winners will be determined according to the official final leaderboard ranking.

HOW PROMPT RUN WORKS

01 — START

Receive the hackathon challenge and understand the problem statement.

02 — PROMPT

Use your preferred Vibe Coding workflow and development tools to plan and build your solution.

03 — BUILD

Develop a modern web application using an eligible technology stack.

04 — SUBMIT

Submit your working project for automated evaluation.

05 — EVALUATE

FAIE automatically evaluates your submission and generates your score.

06 — IMPROVE

Use your remaining submission chances to refine your project.

07 — CLIMB

Your latest valid score is reflected on the official leaderboard.

08 — FINISH

When the submission window closes, the final leaderboard determines the winners.

RULES & GUIDELINES

  1. PROMPT RUN is an individual participation hackathon. Team submissions are not allowed.

  2. The total hackathon duration is 6 hours.

  3. The event is conducted fully online.

  4. The project must be related to web development and must follow the given challenge.

  5. Participants must use a modern web development framework, library, or technology stack.

  6. Raw HTML-only, CSS-only, or Vanilla JavaScript-only projects are not permitted as the primary project stack.

  7. Vibe Coding and AI-assisted development tools are allowed.

  8. Participants may use their preferred modern frameworks, libraries, APIs, development tools, and supporting technologies.

  9. Participants receive 3 submission chances.

  10. Every new valid submission replaces the previous submission for leaderboard purposes.

  11. Only the latest valid submission will be considered for the final score.

  12. The highest score among the three submissions will not automatically be retained.

  13. All submitted projects will be evaluated through FAIE — Frontend Arena Intelligent Evaluation Engine.

  14. Participants must ensure that their submitted project is functional and accessible for evaluation.

  15. Projects should be developed within the official hackathon duration.

  16. Participants may use publicly available documentation, libraries, frameworks, and development resources.

  17. Participants must not submit plagiarized or substantially copied projects.

  18. Any attempt to manipulate the evaluation engine, leaderboard, submission system, or scoring process may result in disqualification.

  19. Participants are responsible for testing their project before making their final submission.

  20. Submissions made after the official deadline will not be considered.

  21. Participants must comply with all technical and submission requirements specified by the organizers.

  22. The final results will be determined according to the official final leaderboard.

  23. The organizers reserve the right to disqualify submissions that violate the rules or compromise the integrity of the competition.

WHO CAN PARTICIPATE?

PROMPT RUN is open to:

  • Students
  • Web Developers
  • Frontend Developers
  • Full-Stack Developers
  • UI/UX Designers
  • Vibe Coders
  • AI-assisted Developers
  • Technology Enthusiasts

Anyone interested in modern web development, Vibe Coding, rapid prototyping, and building digital products can participate.

THE CHALLENGE

Participants will be given a specific problem statement at the start of the hackathon.

Your task is to understand the challenge and build a creative, functional, and modern web solution within six hours.

The project should demonstrate:

  • Clear understanding of the problem
  • Creative solution design
  • Strong UI/UX
  • Functional implementation
  • Modern technology usage
  • Effective development workflow
  • Attention to performance and usability

FINAL RESULT

The competition follows a simple progression:

BUILD → SUBMIT → FAIE → SCORE → LEADERBOARD

Every participant gets three chances to improve their project.

But remember:

Your latest submission is the one that counts.

At the end of the hackathon, the final leaderboard will determine the winners.

One Participant.

Three Chances.

Six Hours.

One Leaderboard.

PROMPT. BUILD. RUN.

prizes.others: Awarded to the Rank #1 participant on the final PROMPT RUN leaderboard in recognition of outstanding performance, creativity, and successful completion of the hackathon challenge.
Awarded to the Rank #2 participant for achieving one of the highest final scores and demonstrating strong technical execution and problem-solving.
Awarded to the Rank #3 participant for achieving a top position on the final leaderboard and delivering an impressive project.
Awarded to all participants who successfully participate in PROMPT RUN, recognizing their effort, creativity, and contribution to the hackathon.
